classification: Post-baseline measurement audit of the same immutable raw outputs; no production improvement or new candidate

methods.rankSource: actual.retrieval.results in saved order; no sorting by score, insertion of missing hits, or paper-page expansion.
methods.paperIdentity: paperId, falling back to sourceId. Repeated identities consume original rank slots but earn relevance credit once.
methods.pageEvidenceIdentity: Each raw hit sourceId/page maps to its explicit evidenceId in manifest-verified frozen fixtures/project.json; verifiedFixtureVersion checked against that source version when available. No inferred page or text-match gold creation. These are frozen-fixture page aliases: raw hits carry no content hash or source version. A matching registry snapshot does not establish which source version was actually served by each hit.
methods.contextSource: actual.retrieval.paperIds and evidenceIds, independently scored as context-selected papers and emitted-evidence prefix coverage, never described as raw ranked search.
methods.metricDefinitions: Recall@K = distinct relevant IDs within first K saved slots / distinct frozen relevant IDs. Precision@5 always divides by 5. MRR uses first relevant saved rank. Missing/non-array ranks or unmappable IDs are unknown. An explicit [] has zero scores for nonempty gold. Empty relevant sets produce null metrics and are reported separately.
methods.cohort: Completed observations whose declared categories include lookup/discovery/retrieval/search/semantic_retrieval; excludes declared corpus and every actual corpus workflow. Corpus tool-selection departures are separate.
methods.uncertainty: Fixed-seed2000 percentile bootstrap of case means; cold/warm stay in the same case cluster. Bilingual clusters are matched pair IDs. These are descriptive intervals on a curated synthetic suite.
methods.rawDepth: Maximum5 returned hits in this cohort. Recall@10 equals Recall@5 because no additional ranks6–10 are available; this does not test a10-hit retrieval depth.
methods.invocation: Arrays are preserved exactly, including []. A separate observedSearchCallsOnly aggregate excludes the initialized empty result from CW-MULTILINGUAL-03, where no search call was observed. The main aggregate measures the saved pipeline output arrays, including that uninvoked routing outcome. Use observedSearchCallsOnly when estimating accuracy conditional on an actual search invocation.
methods.callBoundaries: The adapter flattens LiteratureTools.searchPapers results in call order. This cohort has only one nonempty upper-level call per observation; DISCOVERY-08 has two empty calls. Multiple lower-level QMD calls have no separate result boundaries here and never become extra independent samples.

backendDistribution.interpretation: Every nonempty raw ranked result in this audit cohort is labeled legacy. Actual QMD SDK availability/calls elsewhere do not make these QMD-only retrieval metrics. All-baseline backend counts include unrelated case modes and cannot substitute for cohort attribution.

interpretation.rankVsContext: Different measurement stages on the same run; context evidence can improve page coverage by opening full papers, while local routing can discard a successful raw candidate. Their deltas are not baseline-versus-candidate improvements.
interpretation.calciumPair: English raw search returns P17 page1 while frozen relevant calcium evidence is P17 page2; raw page recall is0 in both languages. Opening the English paper later supplies page2, producing context evidence recall EN1 versus ZH0.
interpretation.primaryCoverage: Only4 primary EctD retrieval cases contribute; they are all dev cases. No primary heldout ranked-retrieval performance is established.
interpretation.emptyGold: For CW-LOOKUP-05, both relevant sets are empty but5 unrelated raw results were returned in each cache condition. This is a separate negative-lookup failure, not an invented recall denominator.
interpretation.grounding: Page identity matching is relevance-label matching only, not semantic entailment, final-answer correctness, or citation validity.
interpretation.servedVersion: Mapping sourceId/page into versioned frozen page labels is not a served-content-version verification. All158 ranked hits lack a version/hash field; registry fixture versions provide context only.

independentValidation.method: Separate read-only agent independently recomputed set/rank metrics directly from saved raw JSON and frozen pages.
